main_text.p: um suum defruitditâ quintain tantâ turbâ, ut facilè fit, confusio oriretur; denique ne nimiâ laborum mole & continuatione obruerentur, sed hac etiam in parte ratio ipsorum haberetur, ne in stata etiam adhuc & justa ætate conficerentur, tantumque non enecarentur laboribus. Hoc autem vicis suæ tempore elapso, domum quisque suam redibant, in urbes nimirum sibi assignatas, in quibus scholas apertas, & per totam terram sanctam dispersas habebant, inspectoresq; erant doctrinæ, ne illa adulteraretur; populo etiam in dubiis & difficilibus casibus consulebant, donec vigesimâquartâ septimanâ rursus appetente, cum turma vel classe suâ Hierosolymam ad ministrandum redirent, Num.3.v.17.& seqq. Num.26.v.57. 1.Paral.6.to-to. 1.Par.23. v.24.& seqq.Luc.1.v.8.9.

Tam ergo accuratam, & victus, & ætatis, & laborum, vel operarum Levitarum & sacerdotum rationem in veteri Testamento habuit Deus. Quòd si, quando sub regibus impiis de horum stipendiis, aut ordine detritum aliquid, aut diminutum fuit; successores reges pii ad Dei præscriptum diligenter hoc correxerunt & restituerunt: quemadmodum in exemplo Davidis, 1.Paral.23. 24.25.26; Ezechiæ, 2.Par.31.v.4. & seqq. Josiæ principumque illius, 2.Paral.35.verf.7; & Nehemiæ, Neh.13; v.10. & seqq.apparet. Atque hæc quidem bonorum ecclesiasticorum, quoad sacerdotum stipendia, ratio in veteri Testamento fuit.

page.notes: The left strip is cropped and rotated at the scan edge; its note fragments are read only where legible and are not complete. Left-strip fragments are placed as notes of the first paragraph for ordering only. The last paragraph is partly repeated in the transcription above: the line "In novo autem Testamento" begins the paragraph, and the final line ends with "facul-" as printed. The printed text of the last line is "stolorum tempore,nulla bona externa, aut facul-". The reader should check the last paragraph against the scan. The word "quoad" in the second paragraph is read as printed in the first lines; the scan is slightly blurred there.
